body.x: LG Electronics participated in ‘CES 2018(Consumer Technology Show)’, the world’s largest IT consumer electronics show held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. from Tues. 9th to Fri. 12th in Jan. and introduced various audio equipment made in collaboration with United Kingdom Meridian Audio.

LG electronics has collaborated with Meridian Audio, representing high-end audio brand, manufactured sound equipment applied with high-quality sound technology optimized for sound bar and portable speaker. Three sound bars can play a lossless sound file containing the original sound. Especially, with up-beat and up-sampling function, these express a general disk as high-quality up to 24bit, 192kHz.

Portable speaker ‘PK series’ sounds full of space with rich bass and clear high-pitched note even it is small. Portable speakers create a sound that changes the mood of space and has aptX™ HD audio codec so liteners can enjoy high-quality sound sources as they are.

Voice recognition artificial intelligence hub ‘ThinQ’ equipped with Google’s artificial intelligence secretary ‘Google Assistant’ is linked to all the smart home-appliances. Through 20W high-quality speakers, you can enjoy listening to music with rich sound.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
